name: Kroxa
description: A titan whose voiding maw obliterated the Phyrexian invaders in the Underworld.

description_citations.text: "Theros (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, Athreos shatters Kroxa's chains so it can destroy the Phyrexians in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos shattered the chains that bound the titan, allowing it to lay waste to the Phyrexian forces.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Athreos sends Kunoros to accompany and restrain Kroxa so it cannot escape the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos sent his hound, Kunoros , to accompany and restrain the titan during its rampage.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Phyrexian forces compleat most of the gods; Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid and Kroxa obliterates invaders outside.
timeline.quote: Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most gods are compleated while Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid, and Kroxa obliterates invaders in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The city of Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
